_readme: Hand-made route fixes, applied on every regeneration. 'skip': quests the route must never use (bugged, removed, not worth it) with the reason. 'notes': text shown under a quest's pickup step. 'dungeon_exempt': dungeon quests the dungeon rule (see gen_route.py) may leave out, with the reason they can't be done. 'dungeon_backlog': per faction, dungeon rule gaps the routes had when the rule was introduced (2026-11-05); fix them in the generator and remove the entry; re-baseline only when a fix raises the number of dungeon quests done (see the generator README). Keys are quest IDs as strings.
